faq.q: Which areas of the UAE do you cover for on-site hydraulic hose work?
faq.a: All seven emirates, plus the Habshan and Al Dhafra gas fields and Al Ain. Our hose bay and warehouse are in Al Qusais, Dubai, and every visit outside Dubai starts there. Each area has its own page listing the zones we work in and what usually decides a visit there.

faq.q: Do you have branches outside Dubai?
faq.a: No. We have one premises: the hose bay and warehouse in Al Qusais, Dubai. Everywhere else is somewhere we travel to, either to build the assembly at the machine or to deliver and fit one built in the bay.

faq.q: What can be made at the machine, and what has to be built in the bay?
faq.a: Most braided and spiral hydraulic assemblies in the common bores and thread forms can be cut, crimped and fitted at the machine from stock on the van. Long lengths, large-bore spiral hose, unusual ends and assemblies that need certification are built in the Dubai bay and brought to site. We say which applies before anyone travels.

faq.q: What should I send before you come out?
faq.a: A photo of the layline printed on the hose cover, photos of both ends, the overall length and where the machine is. If the site needs a permit, a gate pass or an induction, tell us at the same time: on many sites that, not the hose, decides when the work can start.

faq.q: Can you replace every hose on a machine in one visit?
faq.a: Yes. For a rebuild, a machine returning from storage or one with a history of failures, every assembly can be built and fitted in one planned stop and tagged on request, so the next replacement is a part number rather than a measurement.

faq.q: Do you supply certified hoses for oilfield work?
faq.a: Yes. We supply API 7K drilling hoses, API 16C choke and kill lines and API 16D BOP control hoses with their documentation. On rig and plant sites the permit and access regime usually sets the timeline, so staging critical assemblies ahead of planned work is worth doing.

faq.q: Do you service hydraulic systems, pumps or cylinders on site?
faq.a: No. Our on-site work is hose work: making, replacing and routing hydraulic hose assemblies. We do not flush, test or repair hydraulic systems, pumps or cylinders. We do supply pumps, cylinders, valves, adapters and fittings from Dubai stock.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for on-site hose work?
faq.a: Send photos of the hose and both ends, with the length and where the machine is, by WhatsApp or email. We reply with what we would build, whether it is a site job or a bay job, and a written Estimate.

faq.q: What about sites outside the UAE?
faq.a: Outside the UAE we do not send a crew. We build the assembly in Dubai and ship it. Each GCC market has its own page covering the documents, freight options and how an order works.
